high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "artbysehgal," which was posted 4 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The post features a quote on a textured, off-white background that resembles aged paper or parchment. The quote is highlighted in bold yellow text and reads: "The rarest of all human qualities is consistency." This quote is attributed to Jeremy Bentham, as indicated below the quote in smaller black text. At the bottom of the image, there is a watermark or source credit that reads "@thegoodquote.co," suggesting the origin of the quote.
